name: Find meeting slots for a distributed team with HTTP Request and OperatorNest

parameters.content:
## Find meeting slots for a distributed team

For teams arranging a recurring meeting across time zones.

### How it works
The webhook receives a date and 2 to 8 people with IANA time zones. The date belongs to the first person. The public API checks 30-minute slots inside each person’s 09:00 to 17:00 workday. This workflow returns contiguous overlap windows, three ranked slots and an explicit no-overlap result. It does not read calendars or book meetings. API failures stop the run.

### Setup
POST the README example as JSON to the test webhook. Replace the example names, date and zones with your team’s details. Confirm the returned UTC window and local start labels. Test a team with no shared working hours. Then publish and use the production webhook URL. Check each future meeting date separately because DST can change the overlap.

Calculation by [OperatorNest](https://operatornest.com/tools/meeting-time-zone-planner?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=template&utm_campaign=team-meeting-slots). No OperatorNest account required.
